title: Best journal software for 0 DTE?
summary: I've been trialing some trading journal sites and looking for recommendations for one that work well for 0 DTE. Too many to choose from. Here's ideally what I would like to have (at least):Near real-time (and accurate) sync with Schwab/Thinkorswim: as soon as the trades come in, I'd like to record my thoughts and tag the trade.Strategy detection (ICs, verticals, etc.) or some easy way I can group separate trades/legs together.Exact time of trade: important for 0 DTE.Ability to add additional fields for input and calculation. For instance, I have Schwab set up to send the price of the underlying when my trade gets executed. Based on this, I would like add additional calculation fields to attribute my P&L to change in Price, Time, and Volatility.Ability to chart my trades on intraday prices, preferably 1 min bars.Tax reporting/wash-sale detection across accounts.Good, responsive solution-oriented customer service. So far, I've been impressed with TradesViz. My experience with Tradervue was awful to the point where someone senior had to step in, fix the issue, and apologize.Before someone points to this sub's wiki, I've seen it. However, I'm hoping to avoid having to evaluate each one individually so looking for input on the above points for services people have tried.I already do a bunch of stuff in Excel but I would rather automate the transaction input. In addition, there are things in Excel I would rather not spend time developing, like charting my trades on intraday prices.submitted by/u/Affectionate-Heat865[link][comments]

title: [U.S] Trading setup question for profitable Traders for taxes and expense deductions
summary: Hi all, I am based in America and I have been trading stocks and futures for the past 4 years. Overall I am profitable but the amount is less than $60K/year. I am tagged as an investor for my accounts, and I cannot deduct any trading expenses like fees, data subscriptions, softwares, wash sale .. since it is considered passive short term capital gains.1) I wanted to know from profitable traders, for tax purposes are you utilizing Trader Tax Status and MTM? There aren't alot of CPAs that can help.There is only one that I know GreentraderTax but they work with people over 6 figures.2) In order to consider Trading as an active business and deduct expenses against it, TTS is important. I have a job on W2 too. Does working under an LLC is going to be better option?3) I want to use my trading profits as active income, and then deduct expenses against it. Thats the goal. So please share your opinion and experiences.submitted by/u/Azee_09[link][comments]
